```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
pacman::p_load(cmdstanr, tidyverse,posterior, bayesplot, tidybayes,
               brms, patchwork, cowplot,ggpubr,flextable)


source(here::here("Sequential sampling", "utility.R"))

```

## Extracting the data:

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
df = load_data()
```


## plotting the behavioral data:

```{r, fig.height=6,fig.width=8, message=F,warning=F}
plot_beh_data(df%>% filter(Trialtype == "Main", scale == "conf"), 9, F)
```
## check subjects for exclusion and  fit the subject level model for each subject:

```{r}
dd = df %>% 
  mutate(subject = as.numeric(as.factor(subject))) %>% 
  filter(Trialtype == "Main", scale == "conf")

exclusions_correct = dd %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarize(n = sum(Correct)/n()) %>% filter(n < 0.6)
exclusions_ntrials = dd %>% select(interTrial.interval, interval,coherence,X,Correct,Y,RT,Confidence,ID) %>% drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% filter(n < (36*7-30))


dd = dd %>% filter(!ID %in% c(exclusions_correct$ID, exclusions_ntrials$ID))

```


```{r}
dd_by_subj <- split(dd, dd$ID)

if(length(list.files(here::here("Sequential sampling","Fits","Single Subject"))) == length(dd_by_subj)){
  
  models = list.files(here::here("Sequential sampling","Fits","Single Subject"), full.names = T)
  fits = list()
  for(model in models[1:length(models)]){
    fit = readRDS(model)
    paths = str_split(model, "/")[[1]]
    name = paths[length(paths)]
    
    fits[[str_remove(str_remove(name,".rds"),"fit_")]] = fit  
  }
  
}else{
  fits <- lapply(dd_by_subj, function(d) {
  fit_model_ss(d)})
}

```


```{r, fig.width=8,fig.height=6}
diagnoistics_ss = dia(fits, dd)

diagnoistics_ss[[1]]
```


## Fit Hierarchical model

```{r}
if(length(list.files(here::here("Sequential sampling","Fits","Hierarchical"))) != 0){
    model = list.files(here::here("Sequential sampling","Fits","Hierarchical"), full.names = T)
    fit = readRDS(model)
}else{
  fit = fit_model_hier(dd)
}
```


```{r, fig.width=16,fig.height=12}
dia_hier(fit, dd)
```



# posterior predictives:

```{r, fig.width=8,fig.height=6, error=F,message=F,warning=F}
pps = pp_hier(fit, dd, n_bins = 10)

pps[[1]]
```


```{r, fig.width=8,fig.height=6, error=F,message=F,warning=F}
pps[[2]]
```


```{r,fig.height=12, fig.width=18}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Arrange in a 2-row × 4-column grid, collect all legends
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(pps[[2]], ncol = 4, nrow = 2, guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect")

combined_plot = combined_plot+theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
                       axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
                       axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"))


combined_plot


```
